description: Defines the ArmCommandEvent class which represents a simulated command from an ACE client to arm or disarm the system. It extends ClusterCommandEvent and constructs a payload with mode, access code, and zone ID.

classes.name: ArmCommandEvent
classes.description: Represents a command event to arm/disarm the system from the ACE client, constructing a specific payload for transmission.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Builds and returns the byte array payload representing the arm/disarm command, including mode, access code, and zone ID.
